failure_summary: The assistant agent first modified the items in the pending orders before modifying the addresses which locked the orders and hence couldn't update the shipping addresses later. The correct sequence should have been vice-versa.

ground_truth_failures.step_reason: The assistant agent first modified the items in the pending orders before modifying the addresses which locked the orders and hence couldn't update the shipping addresses later. The correct sequence should have been vice-versa.
ground_truth_failures.category_reason: The assistant's plan was incorrect, it should have first modified the shipping address and then the items in the pending orders as per the user request.
